payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the source light-blue mug by its appearance, location, and visual context. Fulfillment requires the source mug itself to be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones; a different or newly appearing mug on the right does not establish this. For incomplete progress, credit only concrete visual evidence that links the source mug to an apparent displacement toward the headphones’ right side, such as a recognizable continuation or intermediate appearance of that mug. A residual blur at the former location together with a separate mug-like object nearby is not, by spatial arrangement alone, evidence that the source mug moved. Do not infer movement merely from the source mug being absent or from an unrelated mug appearing elsewhere. If the images do not resolve whether the apparent displacement is of the source mug, treat the evidence as insufficient.
node.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: a blue blurred remnant appears at the former left-side location, a small white mug is immediately left of/overlapping the headphones, and another white mug is farther right. Neither white mug is visibly identifiable as the source blue mug. Do not treat the remnant and nearby mug as evidence of source-mug displacement unless their visual appearance and context actually support continuity; the far-right white mug alone does not establish that the source mug is now to the right.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
node.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
node.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
node.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source blue mug displaced toward the right of the headphones; absence at its source location, a residual blur alone, or a different mug on the right does not count.
node.half_when: The images provide concrete visual evidence linking the source blue mug to an incomplete displacement toward the headphones’ right side, but do not visibly establish that it is positioned to their right. A blur at the former location plus a nearby mug-like object is insufficient without visual support for continuity.
node.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image; a different white mug on the right or ambiguous blur is not sufficient.

node_traces.evidence: The source light-blue mug is left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blue blurred remnant remains at its former location, while the mugs near and to the right of the headphones are white and are not visibly identifiable as the source mug. The remnant and separate mugs do not establish that the source mug moved toward or to the right of the headphones.
